verses.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਨ ਮੂਲ ਮੂਰਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਜਾ ਮੂਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਣ ਪੁਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhiaan mool moorat guroo poojaa mool gur charan pujaae|

en.bdb: Basis of meditation is the form of Gum (who is with qualities as well as beyond all qualities) and basic worship is worship of the feet of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਕ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ma(n)tr mool gur vaak hai sach sabadh satiguroo sunaae|

en.bdb: Basis of the mantras is the word of the Guru and the true Guru recites the true word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਧੁਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: charanodhak pavitr hai charan kamal gur sikh dhuaae|

en.bdb: The wash of the feet of Guru is sacred and the Sikhs wash the lotus feet (of the Guru).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣਾਂਮ੍ਰਿ ਕਸਮਲ ਕਟੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੂਰੀ ਬੁਰੇ ਲੇਖ ਮਿਟਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: charanaa(n)mr kasamal kaTe gur dhooree bure lekh miTaae|

en.bdb: Nectar of the feet of Guru cuts asunder all sins and the dust of the Guru's feet erases all evil writs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: satinaam karataa purakh vaahiguroo vich ridhai samaae|

en.bdb: By its grace the true named creator Lord, Vahiguru, comes to reside in the heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਤਿਲਕ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਤਿਲਕ ਨੀਸਾਣ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: baareh tilak miTai kar gurmukh tilak neesaan chaRhaae|

en.bdb: Effacing the twelve marks of the yogis, the gurmukh puts on his forehead the mark of the grace of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹੁਰਾਸੀ ਰਹੁਰਾਸਿ ਏਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਤਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: rahuraasee rahuraas eh iko japeeaai hor tajaae|

en.bdb: Out of all religious conducts, only one code of conduct is true that repudiat­ing all, one should go on remembering the one Lord alone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਣ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਫਿਰੇ ਠਉਰ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bin gur dharasan dhekhanaa bhramataa fire Thaur nahee paae|

en.bdb: Following any one other than the Guru, man goes on wandering without any shelter.
De­void of the perfect Guru, jiv goes on suffering transmigration.
